svg.aria-label: Exam scores by cohort — Boxplot diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Box plot of 43 values in 3 groups, Spring, Summer and Autumn; Score ranges from 41 to 99.
